maria (sec-eng): Quick thread: Client asks if we can provide tamper-evident audit exports, HSM-backed keys for Private, and a mapped RBAC matrix they can hand to their auditors. Can we confirm yes/no + short caveats?

arjun (infra): Yes to HSM-backed keys. Private supports BYOK via KMIP or cloud-HSM integrations. Caveat: requires network ingress rules, cert provisioning, and a maintenance window for HSM rotation. Lead time 2-6 weeks typically.

kevin (sales): They also want to know if "full customer key custody" is possible (no Redwood access). Short answer?

arjun (infra): Possible for on-prem Private deployments with legal SOW. For hosted we support BYOK wrap but operator access prevention needs additional contract + attestation.

olivia (oncall): Tamper-evident exports: we generate daily gzipped JSON bundles, compute SHA256 per-bundle, append to a chain file, and sign the chain with our P-256 signing key. We can deliver bundles to customer S3/GCS or an HTTPS endpoint. Include sample verification steps in the one-pager.

maria (sec-eng): RBAC matrix: propose explicit role mapping examples (tenant_admin, tenant_ops, tenant_audit, svc_embed). Include SCIM/SAML mapping note and retention of role assignment audit trail.

security-bot: Created ticket SEC-4999: Corvina attestation + FAQs. Owner: maria. Due: 2026-03-14.

maria (sec-eng): I'll assemble a one-page FAQ and a short checklist for HSM onboarding. Please add any sample log/event fields you want included by EOD.
